title: Systems register and fine-detail workflow: actual degrees, causal uptake and aspect boundaries

reviews.classification: Full router/workflow content review; selected-consumer support and proof scope retained
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full register review covers the making/progression/combat routers, F1 conflict-frame port, W6 source-calendar/environment row, substitution/requirements/save degrees, cultivation and physical continuation rows, five top gaps, G5 material update and Cyoria lore supplement. The register is a code-fit router with dated degrees of support, not a browser-play certificate. A reference to a subsystem body or checkpoint does not review that body. Match the actual selected supplier/export, command, settlement and downstream consumer before describing a capability as live. Preserve the distinction between dormant generic matching/generation, bounded authored material grading, exact known native recipe choice and broader symbolic/potency/risk substitution.

F2. Later scoped receipts qualify the original maps rather than erasing them: P4–P8/party/crowd road-contest cases recorded in the lead-life guide mean the old F1 structural-port no-range/morale/content sentence cannot establish a current whole-game absence. It still describes that port's own stated degree. Nov4 quoteCrafting/stageCrafting parity, world-pack reveal writer and G5/Cyoria released-consumer statements retain their exact owner/evidence scope; this read did not reproduce code or browser results or expand them to general gameplay triggers, arbitrary world crafting or a social simulator. W6 historical sourceCalendarAt is active-instance context rather than a general aging/offline system.

F3. Keep frozen command/job/source revisions and external-piece return-point reservations meaningful. A wornMinutes living-gear copy develops through its declared native equipped played-time consumer, not merely possession, a second clone or elapsed time in every body. Exact physical baggage and retained knowledge are different carriers. Changing a command needs an explicit supported compatibility decision; the old no-edit-without-migration wording does not prohibit current authorized drop/reset choices or imply every documentation update migrates saves. The five gap rows are routed work, not a new universal framework prerequisite. Under AD32 no proposal is adopted here; AD36/AD43 keep source, focused tests, rebuilt behavior and persistence receipts separate. No current runtime census, primary-source or browser proof was renewed.
reviews.evidence: Entire current input delivered in a two-file bounded read. Named linked code/checkpoints/dossiers remain attributed, not fresh linked-body or runtime review.
reviews.reopen: Actual selected system degree or world/aspect consumer changes; update exact existing owner and proof limit without broad re-audit or new authority.

reviews.classification: Full router/workflow content review; selected-consumer support and proof scope retained
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full review covers the world-detail brief, WQ1–WQ6 fine-detail loop, evidence/status vocabulary, medium-specific source treatment and aspect finish condition. This is a saved separately dispatchable workflow, not a launched research or implementation task. Its useful route is actual observed detail to local design implication to existing consumer/missing seam to proposed representation and observable acceptance; a catalogue, schema field, still image or wiki summary cannot substitute for the relevant sequence and causal evidence. Keep atmosphere/contextual information as valid dispositions without inventing a buff, quest quota or new simulation for every sentence.

F2. Preserve stable idea IDs, local exceptions, source edition/era/translation, actual tools/time/actors, interruptions and later consequences. Use existing owner vocabulary to distinguish evidence-needed, design-ready, authorized, implemented-unverified, bounded proof and deferred scope. Whole-world horizon and unread residue survive a successful bounded aspect. S00–S14 and the ordinary-life prompts are coverage aids, not fourteen automatic mandatory rereads for every selected change. Current AD51 qualifies reusable-seam design; AD36/AD43 assign proof and AD42 keeps human review optional.

F3. WQ5's internal questions should resolve from source/code and current direction wherever possible, not become a new questionnaire or permission ceremony. The instruction to stop at an aspect boundary limits that separately selected task's scope; the current authorized project-wide reconciliation continues into other inventory batches without new batch approval. Saving a next idea does not grant runtime/source-acquisition/publication authority. Under AD32 this workflow does not adopt local proposals or change campaign priority. Linked source/playbook bodies and runtime were not freshly reviewed by reading this brief.
